claims.source_quote_ar: ثم ثنى اللَّه سبحانه في شأنهم بتمثيل آخر
claims.claim_ar: تكرارِ أداةِ الشرط «وَلَئِنْ» في بداية الشرطين لتأكيد الموقف ولإضفاء شكلٍ موازٍ يُحسّن أثر التوكيد والتماثل بين الجزئين.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the conditional particle «وَلَئِنْ» at the start of both conditional clauses to emphasize the stance and create parallel structure that enhances the force of the warning.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source discusses general 'ثنى' (doubling/parallelism). Mapping that general remark to the specific repetition of «وَلَئِنْ» in this verse is interpretive and should be reviewed for exact wording in classical balagha sources.

claims.source_quote_ar: ومما ثنى من التمثيل في التنزيل قوله: (وَما يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَلَا الظُّلُماتُ وَلَا النُّورُ وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ، وَما يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْياءُ وَلَا الْأَمْواتُ)
claims.claim_ar: مقابلة وتوازي بين صورتين: (أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ يَتَبَعُونَ/وَأَنْتَ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ) — نمط موازن يُظهر التناقض والسلوك المختلف بين الفريقين عبر تركيب متماثل.
claims.claim_en: A balanced antithetical parallelism between the two patterns (those given the Scripture not following your qibla / and you following their desires) — a symmetrical structure that highlights the contrast between the parties' behavior.

claims.source_quote_ar: فيه التفات من الغيبة إلى الخطاب
claims.claim_ar: التفات من الغيبة إلى الخطاب: الآية تنتقل من الحديث عن جماعةٍ ثالثة (أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ) إلى مخاطبةٍ مباشرة للنبي «أَنْتَ» وقيامه بتحذيرٍ وتحميل مسئولية الاختيار.
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (shift of address) from speaking about a third party to direct address: the verse moves from discussing the People of the Book to directly addressing the Prophet «أَنْتَ», intensifying the reproach and moral responsibility.

warnings: The provided source_chunks are from Zamakhshari and Tabari extracts; the requested authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, and tafsir-balagha sections) are not present among the chunks given. Claims were linked to rhetorical comments found in the supplied chunks and not to the originally requested authors.
Some mappings (e.g., treating the general discussion of 'ثنى' as direct support for the specific repetition of «وَلَئِنْ») are inferential. Review against primary balagha texts is advised.
